title: Cockroach Janata Party calls Tiranga march in Delhi

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against alleged voter list manipulation and the arrest of party members.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the right to wave the national flag.
tea.changed: Oct 14: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke announced a Tiranga march in Delhi for October 16 following the judicial custody of two party members.

summary: The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) has announced a nationwide demonstration called 'Lehra Do Tiranga,' featuring a central rally at Central Park in Connaught Place, New Delhi, on October 16, 2026, alongside decentralized marches in other cities. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke called for the march following the preventive arrest and five-day judicial custody of party members Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. The detained members had previously climbed the locked gates of Jantar Mantar to wave the national flag after the location ceased to be a designated protest venue. The youth-led movement demands the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter list manipulation in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Security forces have prepared heavily with barricades around Connaught Place, anticipating a tense standoff.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Right to wave the national flag without criminal penalisation
response: Delhi Police placed two protesters under preventive arrest after they allegedly climbed the locked gates of Jantar Mantar. A Special Executive Magistrate remanded them to five days of judicial custody, while a third individual was released on bail with a bond.

arrests.text: Delhi Police placed the two men under preventive arrest.

updates.text: Two CJP members were detained after allegedly climbing locked gates at Jantar Mantar during a protest.
CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke announced a nationwide Tiranga march scheduled for October 16 at Central Park, New Delhi.
